2026-08-03 15:13:45.397661 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-08-03 15:13:45.397665 | controller |
2026-08-03 15:13:45.397669 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-08-03 15:13:45.397672 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-08-03 15:13:45.397677 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-08-03 15:13:45.397688 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-08-03 15:13:45.397692 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-08-03 15:13:45.397697 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-08-03 15:13:45.397709 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
